name: 7.3.Verify Page redirections for New Harvesters Product Detail Pages
fullName: 7.3.Verify Page redirections for New Harvesters Product Detail Pages
description:
Verify that the New Harvester product detail page (Mahindra HarvestMaster H12 4WD) (harvester/142/mahindra-harvestmaster-h12-4wd-combine-harvester/) loads successfully and every in-page link (outside the shared header/footer nav) resolves without a 404 or 500 error, with correct trailing slashes on internal links.

Expected: The New Harvester product detail page (Mahindra HarvestMaster H12 4WD) should load successfully (HTTP 200) and every in-page link in scope should resolve to a valid destination — no broken (404) or server-error (500) links, and internal links should end with a trailing slash.
